description: GENERATED by tools/gen_schemas.py from darnlink/gate_config.py: do not edit. The configuration of the darnlink gate recipes, in its canonical form: the recipes accept more (they lower-case flags and read an unknown string as ON); `darnlink gate-config` warns about whatever this schema rejects. Every key is optional; keys starting with `_` are notes.

$schema.description: The schema this file follows (for editors). Ignored by the recipes.

create_readme.description: A link to a folder without a README fails the gate.

create_readme_excludes.description: Extra directory globs for the create-readme pass only.

dangling.description: Links whose target does not exist: off, warn, added-lines or repo.

dangling_max.description: With dangling=repo, how many are tolerated (a budget). Default 0.

default_branch.description: The default branch, to tell a pending link from a broken one.

fail_closed.description: Fail when darnlink cannot run (network, PyPI). Turn it on in CI.

ignore_blocks.description: Generated blocks <!-- NAME-start --> ... <!-- NAME-end --> to skip.

include_mermaid.description: Also watch the links in mermaid `click` directives (needs web).

own_web.description: Owners you control: their web links without a uuid fail (needs web).

own_web_from_origin.description: Take the own_web owner from the origin remote.

own_web_max.description: How many own_web findings are tolerated (a budget).

recipe_sha256.description: sha256 of the recipe, checked by whatever downloads it.

ref.description: What uvx installs: `git+<url>@<tag or sha>`. Pin a published tag's SHA.

ref_comment.description: Why `ref` is pinned where it is. Ignored by the recipes.

ref_tag.description: The tag `ref`'s SHA belongs to. Ignored by the recipes.

web.description: mode=max adds a web-check --online pass over cross-repo links.
